audit_metadata.page_or_scope: S45 — Cloud, almacenamiento, colas e infraestructura
audit_metadata.audience_assumption: Intelligent Level-4 learner who completed prior released prerequisites but should not rely on undocumented cloud/distributed-systems knowledge.

continuity_gate.S02-S44: dedicated JSON evidence present under audit/lessons-only/sections
continuity_gate.decision: S45 selected to close the first missing JSON gap

live_validation.public_card_header: observed S45 title/tagline and 20h on public site
live_validation.deep_spa_tabs: attempted but browser sandbox blocked direct live navigation; canonical source + shared renderer audited instead
live_validation.claim_policy: No deep-live-only claim is marked verified.

major_comprehension_problems: The final project can appear successful while losing every supposedly durable state on process restart.
The lesson's evidence model repeatedly substitutes booleans/process-local collections for persistence, recovery, policy and IaC evidence.
Roadmap/capstone identity is inconsistent: S45 repeatedly calls itself the CP-N4-B gate although S47 is the closure gate.
Practice environment and representations underfit the cloud-lab/emulator target.
The E3 classifier family can let missing fields mask known breaches.
recurring_missing_context: What survives an actual worker restart.
How IAM resource scope is represented and tested.
What counts as actual restore/export/IaC evidence rather than a boolean.
How mixed breach + missing evidence is prioritized.
terminology_inconsistencies: S45 is described as closing/gating CP-N4-B although the roadmap closes it at S47.
Theory says durable dedup/state while worked/project code uses volatile Python collections.
Theory says IAM action+resource while code checks only action.
recommended_global_rules: Kill/restart is a mandatory RED test for every S45 durability claim.
A boolean saying a drill/policy exists is not evidence that it executed.
Known breach and missing evidence are independent dimensions; preserve both.
Keep legacy id `iac` for compatibility but never use it as a semantic content selector.
Every acronym gets full name + practical meaning at first meaningful use.

terminology_registry.plain_language_meaning: Recovery Point Objective: maximum acceptable interval since the recovery point / acceptable data loss.
terminology_registry.recommended_first_introduction: Objetivo de Punto de Recuperación (RPO): cuánto dato, medido como tiempo desde el último punto recuperable, el negocio acepta perder como máximo.

terminology_registry.plain_language_meaning: Recovery Time Objective: maximum acceptable delay to restore service.
terminology_registry.recommended_first_introduction: Objetivo de Tiempo de Recuperación (RTO): cuánto tiempo puede tardar como máximo la recuperación del servicio.

terminology_registry.plain_language_meaning: Identity and Access Management: policies controlling which identity can perform which action on which resource.
terminology_registry.recommended_first_introduction: Identity and Access Management (IAM), o gestión de identidades y accesos: define qué identidad puede ejecutar qué acción sobre qué recurso.

terminology_registry.plain_language_meaning: Infrastructure as Code: versioned declarative infrastructure configuration.
terminology_registry.recommended_first_introduction: Infraestructura como Código (IaC): declarar y versionar el estado deseado de la infraestructura para poder revisar el cambio antes de aplicarlo.

terminology_registry.plain_language_meaning: Architecture Decision Record: short record of a technical decision, context, alternatives and consequences.
terminology_registry.recommended_first_introduction: Registro de Decisión de Arquitectura (ADR): documento breve que deja la decisión, su contexto, alternativas y consecuencias.

terminology_registry.plain_language_meaning: Dead-letter queue: separate terminal queue for messages that repeatedly fail.
terminology_registry.recommended_first_introduction: Dead-letter queue (DLQ), una cola separada donde terminan mensajes que agotaron los intentos para poder inspeccionarlos y reejecutarlos de forma controlada.

terminology_registry.plain_language_meaning: Temporary invisibility lease while a consumer processes a message; without delete/ack before expiry it can become deliverable again.
terminology_registry.recommended_first_introduction: Tiempo de visibilidad (visibility timeout): periodo durante el cual la cola oculta temporalmente un mensaje entregado; al vencer sin confirmación, puede entregarlo de nuevo.

terminology_registry.plain_language_meaning: Mechanism to slow/stop accepting more work before downstream capacity is overwhelmed.
terminology_registry.recommended_first_introduction: Backpressure o control de presión: reducir o pausar la entrada de trabajo cuando el consumidor ya no puede procesarlo dentro del objetivo.

terminology_registry.plain_language_meaning: Level-4 capstone Production Data/ML Platform, whose canonical closure gate is S47.
terminology_registry.recommended_first_introduction: Incremento S45 hacia CP-N4-B (Production Data/ML Platform); S47 es el gate de cierre.

cross_element_issues.issue: Theory's central restart/durability question is not represented in You Do acceptance; volatile collections can pass before restart.
cross_element_issues.recommended_fix: Make process restart/reopen/redelivery a final acceptance test.

cross_element_issues.issue: Roadmap S45 environment is cloud-lab/emulator while all I Do/We Do are local Python predicates.
CP-N4-B is repeatedly presented as S45's gate although S47 is authoritative closure.
cross_element_issues.recommended_fix: Rename all S45 references to incremento hacia CP-N4-B.

cross_element_issues.issue: Shared renderer uses historical id iac as semantic playground key, leaking obsolete Terraform content.
cross_element_issues.recommended_fix: Decouple stable key from current semantic mapping.

cross_element_issues.issue: Missing-first E3 pattern repeats across domains and masks known adverse facts.
cross_element_issues.recommended_fix: Return/retain multiple reasons and prioritize proven breach for blocking.
